new: # Runtime requires exact independently reviewed source release before Run.

ADDITIONAL_DESCRIPTOR_PIN = {'bytes': 69418, 'sha256': '7fed8e2eabd5a2766a04d8823dfacb16d333961b4349dc258fe4bd4631e3906d'}

def require_runtime_release(args):
    """Require the reviewed ordinary-bank/raw-diagnostic phase, before Run writes."""
    release = json.loads((HERE/'root-release.json').read_bytes())
    assert release['status'] == 'PASS_ROOT_CODE_PROVENANCE_RELEASE_ACTUAL_PREPARE_AUDIT_PENDING'
    assert Path(release['materialized_runtime']).resolve(strict=True) == HERE.resolve()
    assert release['worktree_or_index_mutated'] is False and release['source_normalization'] is False
    assert release['production_calls'] == release['prepare_audit_calls'] == 0
    required = ['whitespace282.py', 'additional-root-descriptors.json', 'physical-source-descriptors.json',
                'current-inputs/semantic-review/freeze.json', 'current-inputs/semantic-review/original-to-copy-manifest.json']
    for name in required:
        rows = [row for row in release['files'] if row['copy'] == name]
        assert len(rows) == 1
        raw = (HERE/relative(name)).read_bytes(); check_pin(raw, rows[0])
        assert Path(rows[0]['original']).read_bytes() == raw
    reviews = []
    for dirname, record in release['inputs'].items():
        directory = Path(dirname); check_pin((directory/'freeze.json').read_bytes(), record['freeze'])
        path = directory/'review.json'
        if path.is_file() and pin(path.read_bytes()) == release['approved_review']:
            reviews.append(json.loads(path.read_bytes()))
    assert len(reviews) == 1 and reviews[0]['spec_verdict'] == reviews[0]['quality_verdict'] == 'APPROVE'
    assert reviews[0]['open_findings'] == []
    check_pin((HERE/'whitespace282.py').read_bytes(), reviews[0]['candidate'])
    check_pin((HERE/'additional-root-descriptors.json').read_bytes(), reviews[0]['descriptor'])
    descriptor_raw = (HERE/'additional-root-descriptors.json').read_bytes()
    check_pin(descriptor_raw, ADDITIONAL_DESCRIPTOR_PIN)
    data = json.loads(descriptor_raw); assert data['head'] == HEAD
    check_pin(Path(args.root_manifest).read_bytes(), data['root_manifest'])
    check_pin(Path(args.physical_descriptors).read_bytes(), data['physical_descriptors'])
    for argument, role in [('raw_log','stdout'),('raw_stderr','stderr'),('raw_exit','exit'),('raw_command','command')]:
        path = Path(getattr(args, argument)); item = data['raw_capture'][role]
        assert path.resolve(strict=True) == Path(item['path']).resolve(strict=True)
        check_pin(path.read_bytes(), item)


def load_additional_root(read, descriptor_raw, root_raw, log):
    check_pin(descriptor_raw, ADDITIONAL_DESCRIPTOR_PIN)
    data = json.loads(descriptor_raw)
    assert data['head'] == HEAD
    check_pin(root_raw, data['root_manifest']); check_pin(log, data['raw_log'])
    assert len(data['entries']) == 12 and len({e['path'] for e in data['entries']}) == 12
    actual = parse_log(log)
    assert all(entry['path'] in actual and entry['issues'] == actual[entry['path']] for entry in data['entries'])
    values = {}
    for item in data['evidence']:
        path = Path(item['path']); assert path.is_absolute() and path.resolve(strict=True) == Path(item['resolved_path'])
        raw = read(path); check_pin(raw, item)
        copy = HERE / relative(item['runtime_copy'])
        assert copy.resolve().is_relative_to(HERE.resolve())
        assert read(copy) == raw
        assert item['path'] not in values; values[item['path']] = raw
    for link in data['provenance_maps']:
        rows = json.loads(values[link['manifest']]); rec = link['record']
        assert isinstance(rows, list) and rec in rows
        assert rec.get('original',rec.get('path')) == link['original']
        assert str(Path(link['manifest']).parent / relative(rec['copy'])) == link['copy']
        assert values[link['original']] == values[link['copy']]
        check_pin(values[link['original']], rec)
        if 'freeze' in link:
            frozen = json.loads(values[link['freeze']])
            check_pin(values[link['copy']], frozen['files'][rec['copy']])
    capture = data['raw_capture']
    command = json.loads(values[capture['command']['path']]); execution = json.loads(values[capture['execution']['path']])
    assert command['argv'] == execution['argv'] == ['git','diff','--cached','--check']
    assert command['cwd'] == execution['cwd'] and Path(command['cwd']).is_absolute()
    assert execution['exit'] == 2 and values[capture['exit']['path']] == b'2\n'
    assert not values[capture['stdin']['path']] and not values[capture['stderr']['path']]
    assert values[capture['stdout']['path']] == log
    assert execution['stdout_bytes'] == len(log) and execution['stdout_sha256'] == digest(log)
    assert execution['stderr_bytes'] == 0 and execution['stderr_sha256'] == digest(b'')
    return data, values


def additional_root_predicate(raw, grouped, path, rec, data, values, build, physical):
    """Only the twelve actual files, with exact source/event and literal ownership."""
    entries = [e for e in data['entries'] if e['path'] == path]
    assert len(entries) == 1
    entry = entries[0]
    assert rec == entry['root_record'] and grouped == entry['issues']
    check_pin(raw, entry); literal_warnings(raw, grouped)
    assert raw == values[rec['original']]
    kind = entry['kind']; lines = raw.split(b'\n')
    if kind in ('archived_prior_canonical_csv_crlf', 'archived_current_canonical_csv_crlf'):
        csv_path = 'docs/geshe_michael_roach_dictionary_changes.csv'
        assert raw == values[entry['csv_source']]
        if kind == 'archived_prior_canonical_csv_crlf':
            baseline = json.loads(values[data['prior_baseline']]); assert baseline['commit'] == HEAD
            assert digest(raw) == baseline['sha256'][csv_path]
            directory = Path(data['prior_command_directory'])
            command = json.loads(values[str(directory/'command.json')]); execution = json.loads(values[str(directory/'execution.json')])
            assert command['argv'] == execution['argv'] == ['git','show',HEAD+':'+csv_path]
            assert command['cwd'] == execution['cwd'] and Path(command['cwd']).is_absolute()
            assert execution['exit'] == 0 and values[str(directory/'exit.txt')] == b'0\n'
            assert values[str(directory/'stdin.bin')] == values[str(directory/'stderr.bin')] == b''
            assert values[str(directory/'stdout.bin')] == raw
            check_pin(raw, execution['stdout']); check_pin(b'', execution['stderr'])
        else:
            assert build == json.loads(values[data['current_build_proof']])
            assert digest(raw) == build['output_sha256'][csv_path]
        assert raw.startswith(b'\xef\xbb\xbf') and raw.endswith(b'\r\n')
        assert grouped == {'trailing whitespace.': list(range(1,len(lines)))}
        assert all(line.endswith(b'\r') for line in lines[:-1]) and lines[-1] == b''
        import csv, io
        rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(raw.decode('utf-8-sig'),newline='')))
        assert rows[0] == ['change','wylie','acip','tibetan_generated','english','kind','depth','occurrences','courses','refs']
        assert all(len(row) == 10 for row in rows)
        output = io.StringIO(newline=''); csv.writer(output,quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL).writerows(rows)
        assert csv.excel.lineterminator == '\r\n' and output.getvalue().encode('utf-8-sig') == raw
        return dict(kind=kind,canonical_source=entry['csv_source'],logical_csv_path=csv_path,complete_csv_roundtrip=True)
    if kind == 'archived_cmake_generated_header':
        assert raw == values[entry['generated_original']]
        assert grouped == {'trailing whitespace.':[1,4,5]}
        header = [b'# CMake generated Testfile for ', ('# Source directory: '+entry['source_directory']).encode(),
                  ('# Build directory: '+entry['build_directory']).encode(), b'# ',
                  b'# This file includes the relevant testing commands required for ',
                  b'# testing this directory and lists subdirectories to be tested as well.']
        assert lines[:6] == header and Path(entry['source_directory']).is_absolute() and Path(entry['build_directory']).is_absolute()
        assert Path(entry['generated_original']) == Path(entry['build_directory'])/'CTestTestfile.cmake'
        assert all(line and line.endswith(b' ') and not line.endswith(b'  ') for line in (lines[0],lines[3],lines[4]))
        assert entry['provenance_link_indexes'] and all(data['provenance_maps'][n]['record']['sha256'] == digest(raw) for n in entry['provenance_link_indexes'])
        return dict(kind=kind,generated_original=entry['generated_original'],source_directory=entry['source_directory'],build_directory=entry['build_directory'],literal_header_lines=[1,4,5],provenance_links=entry['provenance_link_indexes'])
    if kind == 'recorded_ctest_json_formatter':
        directory = Path(entry['event_directory'])
        command = json.loads(values[str(directory/'command.json')]); execution = json.loads(values[str(directory/'execution.json')])
        assert command['argv'] == execution['argv'] == entry['argv']
        assert command['cwd'] == execution['cwd'] == entry['cwd']
        assert command['argv'][0] == 'ctest' and command['argv'][-1] == '--show-only=json-v1'
        assert execution['exit'] == 0 and values[str(directory/'exit.txt')] == b'0\n'
        assert values[str(directory/'stdout.bin')] == raw and not values[str(directory/'stderr.bin')] and not values[str(directory/'stdin.bin')]
        assert execution['stdout_bytes'] == len(raw) and execution['stdout_sha256'] == digest(raw)
        assert execution['stderr_bytes'] == 0 and execution['stderr_sha256'] == digest(b'')
        document = json.loads(raw); assert document['kind'] == 'ctestInfo' and document['version'] == {'major':1,'minor':0}
        assert len(document['tests']) == 17 and {test['name'] for test in document['tests']} == set(entry['test_names'])
        assert set(grouped) == {'trailing whitespace.'}
        for number in grouped['trailing whitespace.']:
            assert re.fullmatch(rb' *"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*" : ',lines[number-1])
            assert number < len(lines) and lines[number].strip() in (b'{',b'[')
        all_separators = [i+1 for i,line in enumerate(lines) if re.fullmatch(rb' *"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*" : ',line)]
        assert grouped['trailing whitespace.'] == all_separators
        return dict(kind=kind,event_directory=str(directory),stdout=pin(raw),execution=pin(values[str(directory/'execution.json')]),formatter_separator_lines=all_separators,ctest_reexecuted=False)
    assert kind == 'archived_prebatch_continuation_line'
    history = data['continuation_history']; before = values[history['before']]; after = values[history['after']]
    proof = json.loads(values[history['proof']]); closure = json.loads(values[history['closure']])
    assert proof['status'] == 'PASS_CLOSED279_AND_ONE_MINUTE_STATUS_CHECKPOINT'
    assert proof['next_batch_started'] is False and proof['continuation_prior_bytes_preserved_as_prefix'] is True
    assert proof['recorded_at'] == '2026-09-14T00:08:02.004479+00:00'
    assert closure['final_head'] == HEAD and closure['verified_segments'] == 279
    check_pin(values[history['closure']],proof['closure'])
    before_record = [r for r in proof['before'] if r['path'] == history['before']]; assert len(before_record) == 1
    after_record = [r for r in proof['after'] if r['path'].endswith('/CAMPAIGN_CONTINUATION.md')]; assert len(after_record) == 1
    check_pin(before,before_record[0]); check_pin(after,after_record[0])
    assert after.startswith(before) and raw.startswith(after)
    assert grouped == {'trailing whitespace.':[2357]}
    source_lines = before.split(b'\n'); number = 2357; payload = source_lines[number-1]
    assert payload == lines[number-1] and payload.endswith(b' ') and not payload.endswith(b'  ')
    lo = sum(len(line)+1 for line in source_lines[:number-1]); hi = lo+len(payload)
    assert [lo,hi] == entry['historical_line_range'] and before[lo:hi] == raw[lo:hi] == payload
    assert digest(payload) == history['line_sha256']
    return dict(kind=kind,historical_preimage=history['before'],historical_checkpoint=history['proof'],line=number,byte_range=[lo,hi],exact_prebatch_prefix=True,boundary='Recorded pre-batch external checkpoint; not asserted to be a Git blob or semantic source')
